classes.name: ProjectServiceException
classes.description: Custom exception class for project service errors, providing static methods for common project activity exception scenarios.

methods.name: projectActivityExist
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ProjectServiceException indicating that a project activity cannot be deleted because it has time logged against it.

methods.name: duplicateProjectActivityNameFound
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ProjectServiceException indicating that a duplicate project activity name was found.

methods.name: projectActivityNotFound
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ProjectServiceException indicating that the project activity could not be located.
